events.event_name: 32nd Annual Mexican Independence Day Parade NYC
events.brand: The Mexican Parade Inc. / Comité Cívico Mexicano de NY
events.address: Madison Avenue from East 38th Street to East 27th Street, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: The annual Mexican Independence Day parade celebrating Mexican heritage, culture, music, dance, art, family and community along Madison Avenue.
events.what_is_free: Public viewing of the parade is free.
events.caveats: No advance RSVP requirement is published for spectators. Street closures and crowd-control measures apply.
events.practical_notes: Parade begins at noon at Madison Avenue and East 38th Street and proceeds south on Madison Avenue to East 27th Street.

events.event_name: Light Hill: Art into Action, Educational Gallery
events.what_it_is: A Climate Week educational gallery pop-up featuring thirteen original works by twelve artists that make methane pollution visible through art, data and environmental-health information.
events.what_is_free: The official Climate Week listing describes the week-long gallery as free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Climate Week labels this a public event and explicitly says the gallery is free and open to the public. A registration link is offered, but the source does not state that registration is mandatory for gallery access.
events.practical_notes: Open daily Sept. 21–27, 11 AM–6 PM, at 74 Franklin Street.

events.event_name: Seeing the South: A Photography Exhibition
events.what_it_is: A one-day Climate Week photography exhibition documenting climate change and community responses across the American South.
events.what_is_free: The official Climate Week listing explicitly describes the photography exhibition as free and open to the public during gallery hours.
events.caveats: The gallery is free and public, but it is open only in three windows between live panel discussions rather than continuously all day.
events.practical_notes: Gallery windows are 8–9 AM, 10:30 AM–12:30 PM, and 2–4 PM on Sept. 22.

events.event_name: You Good? Making NYC Green and Affordable
events.address: Leonard Nimoy Thalia at Symphony Space, 250 West 95th Street, New York, NY 10025
events.what_it_is: A live Climate One talk-show and podcast recording about climate, decarbonization and affordability in New York City, presented with Grist.
events.caveats: Symphony Space currently marks the in-person event SOLD OUT. Do not present the RSVP button as actionable inventory unless availability changes on reverification.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 23 at 2 PM; expected runtime 90 minutes. Free in-person inventory is currently sold out.

events.event_name: Rewriting the Climate Story: 10 Years of Solutions
events.address: Leonard Nimoy Thalia at Symphony Space, 250 West 95th Street, New York, NY 10025
events.what_it_is: A Grist Climate Week evening of live storytelling and a Science Friday podcast recording focused on a decade of climate solutions.
events.what_is_free: The organizer describes the event as free; Symphony Space lists the ticket price as $0.
events.caveats: Symphony Space currently marks the event SOLD OUT. Do not present registration as open unless availability changes on reverification.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 23 at 5:30 PM; expected runtime 90 minutes. Free in-person inventory is currently sold out.
